summary: D004 made selector-vector addressability operational, but the selected surface still overexplains validation and reads too much like a receipt.
strengths: selected-line spans map to fixed shadow slices
external apparatus is genuinely required to recover the full object
machine disclosure is structural rather than apologetic
failures: selected path contains too many mechanism nouns
surface asks readers to understand the validator before it earns feeling or pressure
branch packet is more interesting than the visible poem
revision_directive: Preserve selector-vector machinery but compress the selected surface into fewer, less explanatory lines; move machine/proof/packet language into hidden branch endings and receipts.
non_claim: This review authorizes revision only; it does not claim that the replacement draft is good.
